picks.b: A teacher wakes alone on a spaceship with no memory and must work out how to save the sun.
In a world broken by catastrophe, a young Earthbender learns she is the next Avatar.
A hopeless romantic gets exactly what he wished for, and it goes very wrong.
Two Green Lantern cops, one rookie and one legend, chase a murder mystery on Earth.
Bonnie's new tablet makes life hard for Woody, Buzz and the toy gang.
Vision, hunted and pulled toward Ultron's influence, has to face what he really is.
A determined climber stakes everything on being first to the top of Everest.
A band of disgraced MI5 agents with a rude boss stumble through the spy world.
The Joestar family spends generations feuding with the villainous Dio Brando.
A strange doorway turns up in the basement of a furniture showroom.
A couple turn their inherited country house into a B&B full of ghostly guests.
A young man in debt takes odd jobs from a mysterious agency, and they turn nightmarish.
